title: .mexxi.json
why: Some settings belong to a repository rather than to whoever runs the task, so they are committed with it.
description: Optional settings a repository commits in .mexxi.json at its root. mexxi reads them from the default branch, so a task branch cannot change the rules it is checked by.

verify.description: The command that says whether the repository works, with a pass or a fail. A repository with one reliable command already, such as make check, names it here instead of adding an npm script.

ciCheck.description: The CI job that runs the full verify command, such as verify on GitHub Actions. When it succeeded on exactly the commit a task starts from, the task cites it instead of running verify again.

forge.description: github or gitlab, for a repository whose remote mexxi cannot place, such as one on a self-hosted forge. It wins over forge.hosts in config.json.
